verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a locally run, agent-driven video production tool. Issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question for such a product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows the app consuming third-party API keys (Yating, ElevenLabs) and limiting agent concurrency. Neither lets a user issue scoped credentials, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
